name: sdd-helpers
description: A grounding gate holding sdd decision-graph writes and owner questions to real reads of the graph, and checked graph captures from a draft file, each with a skill

grounding_gate_enabled.title: Switch on the grounding gate
grounding_gate_enabled.description: sdd-grounding-gate: the sdd reads owed before a question, draft or capture; off, sdd-capture goes off with it; default on

capture_enabled.title: Switch on sdd-capture
capture_enabled.description: sdd-capture: capturing sdd entries from drafts; off, it refuses; default on

capture_remove_draft.title: sdd-capture: remove the draft
capture_remove_draft.description: Delete a draft once its entry is captured, unless git tracks it or it lies outside the work tree, the graph repository's work tree and /tmp; off keeps every draft; default on
